verdict.rationale: Slack supports bot/app members that can be @mentioned and respond via the Events API (message/app_mention events) and Web API chat.postMessage, and Slack explicitly markets AI agents (Slackbot, ChatGPT/Claude integrations, coding agents) participating in channels when addressed. However, evidence is mostly high-level marketing/docs rather than a concrete step-by-step 'add an agent as a channel member that responds to @mentions' walkthrough, and there's no independent/hands-on confirmation of this exact flow. Missing for 10: a dedicated tutorial/example showing bot channel membership + mention-triggered reply end-to-end, and independent verification that third-party AI agents work this way in practice.
